description: Check current account usage. Returns daily/monthly post counts, scheduled post counts, channel counts, and media storage usage. Also returns channelSlots — purchased extra channel slots ($2.99/month each, available on every plan; a seat-based subscription whose unused slots are auto-canceled before renewal): each active slot raises the effective total channel limit by one and allows one channel above the per-platform cap; per-slot autoRenews says whether it renews or lapses at expiresAt. Use this when the user asks about plan limits or current usage.
name: get_quota_usage
title: Get quota usage
